items.title: Oliver Nelson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 10, 2020
items.q: Carol Kaye, a member of the Rat Pack, Carol Kaye that did all the stuff — well he’d write parts out for Fender bass. He called her “Fender Bass” and he’d have parts for her to play the Fender bass on.

ctx.x: Wow. And I bet you wouldn’t want to be the person in the band who made a real clunker.
Oh no, no, no, no, no. You really wouldn’t. But you know what he tried to conduct, and he found guys that would really work well with him. So actually I was talking — who © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-

was I talking to — oh it was Sheridon Stokes is a flute player. And he did some stuff in California with Dad and one time he said well they needed somebody to play tympani. Well Dad went back and played the tympani. So you do whatever it takes to make the deal work. I mean there was a lot of different interesting people.
